inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL multi-table UPDATE joins a target table through a link table and a classification table, then changes only target rows whose joined classification matches a predicate.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a catalog-policy refresh. A three-table joined UPDATE copies a matched policy lifecycle into linked catalog items, while nonmatching policies and items without the target policy remain unchanged.

fixture_notes: Item 4101 links to the retire policy and changes from listed to retired; item 4103 already has the retire lifecycle, item 4102 links to a hold policy and remains listed, and item 4104 has no policy link and remains listed.
determinism_notes: All IDs, policy names, lifecycle values, join keys, and final reads are fixed and ordered. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, lifecycle VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE item_policy_links (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, policy_id INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE lifecycle_policies (policy_id INT PRIMARY KEY, policy_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, target_lifecycle VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE catalog_items AS i JOIN item_policy_links AS l ON l.item_id = i.item_id JOIN lifecycle_policies AS p ON p.policy_id = l.policy_id SET i.lifecycle = p.target_lifecycle WHERE p.policy_name = 'retire'

checks.sql: SELECT item_id, item_name, lifecycle FROM catalog_items ORDER BY item_id
SELECT item_id, policy_id FROM item_policy_links ORDER BY item_id
